name: Malin's Request
summary: Skuerto gives you a sealed letter for Archmage Malin, who is found in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. It tells Malin that Kryten and Skuerto will be home soon, and Skuerto is certain Malin will repay you well for helping them in Arathi.

sections.title: A Letter for the Archmage
sections.body: After the work in Arathi, Skuerto hands you a letter to take back to Stormwind. Its message for Archmage Malin in the Mage Quarter is that Kryten and Skuerto will be home soon. Skuerto has no doubt that Malin will repay you well for helping them, and sends you off with a wish for a safe journey.

sections.title: Malin Reads the Letter
sections.body: When Malin opens the letter, his eyes grow wide. He is delighted, and says Trelane will be so pleased. He supposes Kryten and Skuerto share his excitement now that they are heading home to Stormwind.

faq.q: Who sends you with the letter?
faq.answer: Skuerto does. The letter tells Malin that he and Kryten will be home soon.

aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: Archmage Malin is in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
Kryten is Skuerto's companion in the Arathi Highlands. Skuerto says the two of them will be home soon.
It follows Attack on the Tower, the work Skuerto asked of you at the tower in Arathi.
